verdict.line: You lose if you facetank his Granite Shield and Ground Slam (E) on cooldown trades; you win if you force all-ins behind Death's Grasp (E) pulls and isolate him with Realm of Death (R) before he can disengage.

brief.thesis: Malphite's Granite Shield absorbs clean pokes when it's fully recharged, but Mordekaiser's Q (Obliterate) deals bonus damage to a single target and his E (Death's Grasp) drags Malphite into range on demand, so Mordekaiser dictates when the fight happens instead of trading evenly. That structural initiative is why Mordekaiser sits at 58.8% over 119 games here with both lane and solo-kill advantage, despite Malphite's shield making the first few trades feel deceptively even.

theirWindow.when: His Granite Shield is fully recharged
theirWindow.what: Don't throw Q into a full shield just to poke; it eats the damage for free. Walk away and let it bait you, or force him to use Ground Slam (E, 7s cooldown) to strip your attack speed before you commit anything.

yourWindow.when: His shield is down or E is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Land E (Death's Grasp) to pull him in, then Q for the single-target bonus damage. This is also when your passive (Darkness Rise, 3 hits to proc) actually lands cleanly since he can't punish the attack-speed window with Ground Slam.

powerCurve.note: Granite Shield absorbs early single-target pokes
E unlocks all-in combos, Q cooldown drops
R isolates Malphite for solo kills
Rylai's and Riftmaker outscale his armor stacking
His R becomes a teamfight tool, lead banked

start.why: Highest-performing start here (58.6% over 99 games, 61.5% pick). The extra AP and mana sustain let you spam Q to poke through his shield recharge windows without running dry.

boots.why: 56.5% win rate over 92 games and the most picked boots. Malphite's Q (Seismic Shard) steals your movement speed and both his Q and E hit for magic damage, so tenacity and the MR directly counter his kit.

core.why: The slow from your Q and E lets you stick to Malphite, who has no reliable escape before level 6.
Omnivamp keeps you topped up through his Ground Slam poke, and the true damage ramp helps you break his armor stacking.
Percent max-health burn punishes Malphite's naturally high HP pool once he starts building tank items.

situational.when: he or his jungler lean on magic damage and you need more healing out of W (Indestructible)
his jungler is diving behind Unstoppable Force (R) and you need to survive the knock-up window
he's kiting you with Seismic Shard's slow and you need to close the gap for E (Death's Grasp)

runes.keystoneWhy: Most-run page here (62.1% win rate, 40.5% pick). The stacking adaptive force and healing reward exactly the kind of extended, sustained trade this matchup turns into once you're pulling him in with E.

summoners.why: Flash + Ignite is the highest-performing and most-picked page (61.5% over 64.6% pick) and converts your solo-kill advantage into actual kills once R isolates him. Flash + Teleport (46.7%, 28% pick) is the alternative if you'd rather bank your lane lead into wave resets and side-lane pressure.

playing.title: Don't poke a full shield
playing.detail: Granite Shield recharges whenever Malphite hasn't been hit recently. Throwing Q into a fresh shield wastes the bonus single-target damage for nothing.

playing.title: Pull before he sets up
playing.detail: Use E (Death's Grasp, 700 range) to drag him into Q range on your terms rather than walking up and eating his Ground Slam first.

playing.title: Hit him alone with Q
playing.detail: Q (Obliterate) deals increased damage when it only hits one target, so angle it onto Malphite specifically instead of cleaving minions in the trade.

playing.title: Respect his Ground Slam timer
playing.detail: Ground Slam (E, 7s cooldown) cuts your attack speed, which slows down your 3-hit Darkness Rise proc. Don't initiate right as it comes off cooldown.

playing.title: Bank Indestructible before all-in
playing.detail: Let W (Indestructible) store damage from the poke phase so you have a shield to consume into healing the moment you commit to the kill.

playing.title: Isolate with R at 6
playing.detail: Realm of Death removes him from his team entirely and steals a share of his stats, turning a close fight into a clean solo kill with no outside peel.

playing.title: Don't overextend into his R range
playing.detail: Unstoppable Force has 1000 range and knocks up on arrival. Once he's level 6, dueling at the edge of your own vision invites a gank you can't walk away from.

brief.patchCaveat: Win rates, build paths, runes, and summoner spells above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning and trade timing are my own tactical read, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Malphite’s (E) reduces your attack speed, placing you at a disadvantage. Keep this in mind when using your abilities off cooldown to gain lane control.
